eps.t: Moon Girl and Devil Dinosaur: Me and Mimi
eps.o: When the Lafayette family leaves for the day, Lunella and her grandma, Mimi, decide to spend the day doing a bunch of super secret science experiments together.

eps.t: Phineas and Ferb: Isabella's Romantic Fails
eps.o: When Isabella spots Phineas in his backyard, she's determined to give her epic crush a present to make her true feelings known.
When the vain Bucky breaks a mirror, he's instantly struck with a string of bad luck. Can he break the curse before he breaks a bone?

eps.t: ZOMBIES: The Problem With Pom Poms
eps.o: When Eliza's new growth serum accidentally falls onto Addison's cheerleading pom pom, the Zombies crew must act fast to defeat this peppy new monster.

eps.o: Chibi versions of your favorite characters see eye to eye and gather to tell a Goofy story that really stands out from the crowd.
Kiff is known for her iconic version of dancing "the worm." But can she win a dance battle against...an actual worm?

eps.t: Stugo: Kids Vs Mutants: Who Is Faster?
eps.o: Buckle up. Pliny and Merian hit the track in a wild go-kart race against a mutant crocodile. Who'll come out on top?

eps.t: Stugo: Kids Vs Mutants: Who Is More Civilized?
eps.o: The ultimate test of manners is here. Can the StuGo kids and mutants actually sit down and share a meal...or is a food fight inevitable?

eps.t: Stugo: Kids Vs Mutants Vs Monsters: Who Is More Nurturing?
eps.o: Larry, a mutant, and a monster face off in Dr. Lullah's ultimate nurture test - who can protect their egg the best without cracking under pressure?

When Eugene collapses through a rickety bridge, it's up to Rapunzel, Pascal, and Maximus to save him from doom.
Emperor Belos will stop at nothing to get revenge on Helen when she accidentally makes him spill his smoothie.

eps.t: Prep and Landing: As Told by Chibi
eps.o: Sing along with Jordan Fisher as he retells the story of Disney's 'Prep and Landing' to the tune of 'Jingle Bells.'

eps.t: Big City Greens/Phineas and Ferb: The Decorator-Inator
eps.o: Dr. Doof tries to ruin the Green family's Christmas decorations by turning them evil. But Cricket and Alice have a plan to stop him.

eps.t: Big City Greens: Snow Shovel Trouble
eps.o: After a big snowfall, Bill wants Cricket to shovel the front lawn, but Cricket has other ideas.

eps.t: Phineas and Ferb: Doof's On The Naughty List
eps.o: When Santa gives Dr. Doof coal for Christmas, Doof invents a Coal-inator ray to try to get revenge on old Saint Nick. But luckily Agent P is there to thwart him.
